Films with replacement_cost greater than or equal to 20.99; per rating, average rental_duration and average of per-film (rental_rate / replacement_cost); then one row with the unweighted average of the per-rating durations and the unweighted average of the per-rating ratios

Films with replacement_cost strictly greater than 20.99; the final single row only (macro-average of per-rating average durations, macro-average of per-rating average ratios), without showing the per-rating rows

Films with replacement_cost strictly greater than 20.99; per-rating rows shown first and then the single summary row, both in one result set
Films with replacement_cost greater than 20.99; the final row computed as the overall average over all qualifying films (weighted by film count) rather than the average of per-rating averages

Films with replacement_cost greater than or equal to 20.99; the final row computed as the overall average over all qualifying films (weighted by film count) rather than the average of per-rating averages
Ratio interpreted as replacement_cost divided by rental_rate instead of rental_rate divided by replacement_cost
Films with NULL rental_duration, rental_rate, or replacement_cost excluded from each average separately versus excluded from both averages whenever any of the values is missing
Ratings with no qualifying films omitted versus included with NULL averages (affecting the average of per-rating values)
The cutoff 20.99 applied as a replacement_cost value compared against films' replacement_cost versus "pricier" interpreted relative to rental_rate (e.g., cost above 20.99 in total price terms)
Final values returned unrounded with full precision, durations and ratios as separate columns in that order
queries:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_duration, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT rating, avg_duration, avg_ratio FROM r
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, AVG(avg_duration), AVG(avg_ratio) FROM r

WITH r AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_duration, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT rating, avg_duration, avg_ratio FROM r
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ALL', AVG(avg_duration), AVG(avg_ratio) FROM r

WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_duration,
         AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(replacement_cost) AS ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT rating, avg_duration, ratio FROM per_rating
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, AVG(avg_duration), AVG(ratio) FROM per_rating;

WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_duration,
         AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(replacement_cost) AS ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT rating, avg_duration, ratio FROM per_rating
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, AVG(avg_duration), AVG(ratio) FROM per_rating;

SELECT AVG(avg_length), AVG(avg_ratio)
FROM (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
